scheduling.skillGoal: Generate or update an index.md in a target folder that lists every doc with concise content-derived descriptions, grouped by type and subdirectory
scheduling.intentSignature: Generate or update an index.md for a target folder
intentSignatures: Generate or update an index.md for a target folder
Create or update an index of all files in a specific folder
Build a directory index referencing all docs
Refresh the index.md so it covers every file in the folder
triggerPatterns: user requests to create or update an index of all files in a specific folder
user asks to generate or refresh index.md for a directory

ioContract.inputsRaw: Target directory path provided by the user.
ioContract.outputsRaw: An index.md at the target folder root containing `# Directory Index`, a `## Files` section listing each file as **[filename.ext](./filename.ext)** - description, and per-subdirectory `## Subdirectories` / `### subfolder/` blocks with the same bullet pattern. Relative paths starting with ./. Hidden files skipped unless specified.

preconditions: target directory exists and is accessible
user has write permissions to create index.md in the target directory
files in the target directory are readable for content-derived descriptions

structural.sceneGoal: List all files and subdirectories in the target location
Group files by type, purpose, or subdirectory; sort alphabetically within groups
Read each file and produce a concise (3-10 word) content-derived description
Write or update the index.md following the documented output format with relative paths and grouped listings

logical.description: Verify the target directory exists, is accessible, and is writable; HALT if not
List all files and subdirectories in the target location, skipping hidden files (starting with .) unless specified
Organize files by type, purpose, or subdirectory and sort alphabetically within each group
Read each file's contents to determine its actual purpose
Generate a concise (3-10 word) content-derived description for each file — do not guess from filenames

Render the index body using the documented output format — `# Directory Index`, `## Files` bullets, and per-subdirectory `## Subdirectories` / `### subfolder/` blocks with **[name](./relative)** - description bullets
Write or update index.md at the target directory root with the rendered body
